invented.quote: The supply boat may not make it.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a supply boat as part of the game's setting or events.
The brief only says the game is about a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, without specifying the lighthouse is on an isolated rock.

invented.quote: You'll share food and fuel, fix what the weather breaks, look after each other when someone gets sick or loses heart, and keep the light burning for the ships that depend on it.
invented.why: The brief does not mention any of these specific gameplay actions or mechanics.
The brief states that playtest sessions have run since 2023, not when the designer started creating the game.

invented.quote: friends, strangers, families, experienced gamers and people who had never played a co-op game before.
invented.why: The brief only states that about 60 different people playtested the game, with no details on who they were or their gaming experience.

invented.quote: Every session changed something. The version you're backing has been reworked, rebalanced and simplified based on what those players showed me.
invented.why: The brief gives no information about what happened during playtesting or how the game was changed afterward.

invented.quote: where people sat down with strangers and played it start to finish.
invented.why: The brief and additional notes only state that people played at the designer's table at two conventions, not that they were strangers to each other or that they played the game start to finish.

invented.quote: But it tells me the game works for people who aren't my friends.
invented.why: The brief does not state whether the 23 people who rated the game were or were not friends of the designer.

invented.quote: More than **1,240 of you** signed up to hear about this launch.
invented.why: The brief says 1,240 people signed up for the launch email, not more than 1,240.

invented.quote: I spend my days reading terrain and thinking about how people find their way through hard country. This game came from the same place.
invented.why: The brief only states the designer works full time as a land surveyor, not what their daily work entails or that it inspired the game.

invented.quote: I'll post updates about manufacturing, delays and problems as they happen, including the bad news.
invented.why: The brief does not mention an update schedule or content, and the additional notes only commit to posting an update every two weeks.

invented.quote: that you can play with your partner, your kids or by yourself.
invented.why: The brief specifies the game is for 1 to 4 players, but does not state whether it is suitable for kids.
